scope: K5 PL06 T03 B02 — Komponen Landskap — Bariah review build v0.3
standing: All entries are confirmed-CAIR-provisional. None is a canonical freeze, a production approval, an MMD build authority or a final source-custody closure.

decisions.title: Module DOCX SHA-256 integrity exception
decisions.ruling: The exact module DOCX SHA-256 could not be obtained because all authenticated routes were unavailable and the only remaining MCP route returns the full 16.8 MB file as one unbounded base64 result.

attempted_routes.detail: MCP get_file_metadata returns no checksum field of any kind.

attempted_routes.route: Authenticated Drive API with container CLOUDSDK_AUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN
attempted_routes.detail: Invalid Credentials — token is a Google Cloud SDK credential without Drive scope.
Agent proxy policy denial logged at 2026-07-31T13:32:31.708Z.

Schema accepts only fileId and exportMimeType. A 504-byte probe returned the entire file as one base64 string, confirming all-or-nothing behaviour. A 16.8 MB transfer would return ~22.4 MB of base64 in one tool result and has a silent-truncation failure mode that would yield a wrong hash.

independent_pdf_reconciliation.method: Every physical table row in the rendered PDF classified by geometry alone, without reference to the matrix.
independent_pdf_reconciliation.conclusion: 26 meaningful source rows confirmed from the hashed PDF alone.

a09_phantom_row_evidence.mechanism: Markdown pipe table emitted with an empty header row; correlation 9/9 with the two control components that carry a marked header row.

decisions.substitution_prohibited: No other file hash, fileId, byte size or modifiedTime is recorded as a substitute for the missing DOCX SHA-256.

decisions.title: VO source fidelity
decisions.ruling: Use proposition-preserving, source-bound VO. VO may restructure source language for narration, but every factual proposition must remain traceable, no unsupported fact, example or claim may be added, every VO record retains a source locator, and unconstrained creative paraphrasing is prohibited.
decisions.supersedes: S&G v1.0 6.1 verbatim-copy requirement, for this B02 review build only
decisions.implemented: All 26 popup VO and 9 main-screen VO carry a module page locator in production metadata.

decisions.title: Table-derived popup VO
decisions.ruling: Follow the B02-specific Updated S&G v0.2: every included table-derived popup must contain VO.
decisions.supersedes: S&G v1.0 5.4.1 general No-VO selection rule for tables and reference lists, for this provisional B02 review build

decisions.title: State representation
decisions.ruling: Use runtime states, not a physical learner slide for every status transition. For Bariah review, popup and completion states may be represented as separate PowerPoint review pages. A popup remains a state and does not create navigation Level 3. Maximum learner navigation depth = 2.

decisions.title: Closing structure
decisions.ruling: Generate Rumusan, Kuiz and Tamat for this Bahagian.
decisions.supersedes: S&G v1.0 4.3 per-Topik placement, for this bahagian
decisions.implemented: RUMUSAN, KUIZ and TAMAT generated as physical learner screens.

decisions.title: Kembali semantics
decisions.ruling: Kembali belongs to the Contoh [Nama Komponen] example screen. It starts disabled, enables after all component Level 2 items are viewed, returns to the relevant Level 1 group master, and remains enabled on revisit and LMS resume.
decisions.implemented: PREMATURE_KEMBALI = 0. Kembali absent from main explanation screens.

decisions.title: Rumusan structure
decisions.ruling: Do not display the learner-facing labels Kepentingan, Apa Yang Dipelajari, Isi Utama or Manfaat. The underlying logic may guide ordering. Use contractor/site-application language and avoid generic 'anda' framing.

decisions.title: PL pronunciation note
decisions.ruling: Retain the production note 'VO PL satu, bukan PL kosong satu, dan seterusnya.' It must remain off-canvas.
decisions.implemented: Present in the S01 off-canvas production panel; absent from every learner canvas.

decisions.title: S03 Mind Map
decisions.ruling: Include a textual Mind Map visual direction on S03. Do not create or embed a final Mind Map asset.
decisions.implemented: S03 carries a Mind Map specification in text. No Mind Map asset produced.

decisions.title: Single-row source tables
decisions.ruling: Preserve source identity: Papan Tanda = 1 meaningful source row; BBQ Pit = 1 meaningful source row. For this review build create Contoh Papan Tanda and Contoh BBQ Pit, each with one Level 2 clickable item opening one popup, with Kembali enabling after that item is viewed. Do not split these source rows during this run and do not remove their example screens.
decisions.note: Interaction decomposition never rewrites source-row identity. SOURCE_ROW_COUNT stays 26 under every A-05 option.

decisions.title: Heterogeneous table structures
decisions.ruling: Use an adaptive popup schema. Display only source-attested fields: Jenis/Bahan when available, Fungsi & Penerangan when available, Contoh when available, and source image or visual direction when available. For missing fields do not render an empty learner-facing heading, do not invent replacement content, and record NOT_PRESENT_IN_SOURCE in production metadata.
decisions.implemented: Popup fields emitted per row from source presence. Jenis/Bahan is additionally suppressed where it duplicates the popup heading verbatim.

decisions.title: DOCX / PDF source precedence
decisions.ruling: For this review build: DOCX governs textual propositions; the rendered PDF governs visible table structure, row boundaries, pagination and image ownership; conversion-only empty rows with no independent proposition are excluded.
decisions.implemented: 7 phantom rows excluded; 26 DATA rows confirmed independently from the hashed PDF.

decisions.title: Ambiguous parenthesis in Kerusi Komposit
decisions.ruling: Do not silently correct the unbalanced parenthesis.
decisions.source_form: Kerusi KompositContoh: WPC - Wood-Plastic Composite / Plastik Kitar Semula):
decisions.note: Two readings exist — a dropped opening parenthesis, or a stray character. Choosing either would change how the cell parses into jenis_bahan and contoh.

source_baseline_preserved.statement: No source-row ID, row order, locator or image-ownership finding was altered. No interaction decomposition was converted into a source row.
